title: Brian Gutekunst: Micah Parsons "doing great right now," but still unlikely to be ready Week 1

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Brian Gutekunst: Micah Parsons "doing great right now," but still unlikely to be ready Week 1
sources.description: Packers edge rusher Micah Parsons is making good progress in his rehab from a torn ACL, but it continues to sound like he will not be ready to play at the start of the season.
